remaining.summary: The production synthetic video was loaded in Chrome before deployment. The Chrome connection stopped responding before the post-deployment keyboard QA; keyboard migration, rate cycling and clock/audio timing were verified by automation.

resolution.summary: Added Classic preview playback speed controls. L starts playback and cycles 1×/1.5×/2×/3×/4×/1×; J steps down to 1×; K resets to 1×. The canonical viewer rate preserves content history, and audio scheduling reanchors with the video clock. Migrated legacy default key assignments while preserving custom actions. Native registry and web tests passed, the production build and matched server checks passed, and 1b22ac55b was deployed.
